info.name: Warden – Bitwarden & Vaultwarden
info.summary: Bitwarden and Vaultwarden vault access with SSO for Nextcloud
info.description:
Access Bitwarden and Vaultwarden vaults directly from Nextcloud.
Warden supports classic master-password authentication, Vaultwarden TOTP, OIDC single sign-on, WebAuthn-PRF passkey vault unlock, personal and organization vaults, collections, folders, encrypted attachments, passkey-aware login entries, SSH keys, password generation, bulk operations and trash.
Bitwarden Cloud US, Bitwarden Cloud EU and compatible self-hosted Bitwarden or Vaultwarden servers are supported.
Vault encryption, decryption and key derivation take place in the browser. The master password and plaintext vault contents are not transmitted to the Nextcloud server.
